title: A test double captures emitted lines for assertion without touching stdout
asA: test author verifying that the application emits the expected log lines during a test
iWant: a test double the factory produces that captures emitted lines in memory instead of writing to stdout
soThat: assertions on log emissions do not depend on stdout capture and do not pollute test output

acceptanceCriteria.description: The blueprint's guide names an in-memory capture mode of the factory contract that returns an ordered array of the emitted structured objects; the capture mode is a documented API of TAC-1601 and can be constructed in a test without any stdout redirection.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a test that constructs the factory in capture mode
acceptanceCriteria.when: the code under test emits any number of log lines
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned array contains one entry per emission with the same object shape the runtime writes to stdout, and stdout carries no line

acceptanceCriteria.description: The in-memory capture mode maintains insertion order; emissions issued in the order A, B, C appear in the returned array as A, B, C at indexes 0, 1, 2, with the same shape a stdout sink would have written.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a factory in capture mode with no ambient correlation context and a caller issuing three distinct emissions in order
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned array has length 3 with emissions in insertion order and each entry's shape matches the shared minimum field set

acceptanceCriteria.description: Constructing the factory in capture mode does not open stdout: an assertion that captures the process's stdout file descriptor writes across the same test finds zero bytes written by the factory. The mechanism has no documented failure path beyond a caller misusing the capture-mode flag; the standard stdout-vs-capture confusion is caught by AC-15107-1.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a test that constructs the factory in capture mode and intercepts stdout for the entire scope
acceptanceCriteria.when: the code under test emits any number of lines
acceptanceCriteria.then: the intercepted stdout carries zero bytes attributable to the factory; every emission is on the returned capture array
